_help: Back End fixes, applied on every 'npm run convert'. Use ids from 'npm run convert -- --list'. same_place: the two entries are one place (keep's position and photo stay; merge's paths and names move to keep). not_same: close pairs that are different places. remove: drop an entry and its paths. change: set name, category, aliases (list), landmark, description, verified, or waypoint (true = a named junction/walkway used in directions but not listed as a destination). See README.txt.
_notes: faculty_of_technology is the Faculty of Technology BUILDING (Samuel, 23 Oct). Ezekiel had saved the lecture theatre under the same name, so his entry was replaced.
The lecture theatre was re-saved by Samuel on 23 Oct as faculty_of_technology_lecture_theatre (nicknames: Chemengine, Chem Engine; old name Chemical Engineering Lecture Theatre).
intecu (Samuel, 23 Oct) and intercu_computer_station (older save) are the same INTECU building; the newer save's position is kept (confirmed by Samuel, 26 Oct).
_not_same_help: Pairs under 15 m apart that the team confirmed are DIFFERENT places, so the converter stops asking about them.
